Supplying Local Distributors Worldwide

Factory supply structured for repeat purchasing, cleaner local resale and more predictable margin control.

1

Direct Factory Supply

Products move directly from factory production to shipment, with no extra reseller layer added in between.

Result: cleaner sourcing path and more stable batch consistency.

2

Kit-Based Packaging

Supply is organized in standard kits, matching upstream distribution logic rather than retail-style single-vial handling.

  • Stronger batch consistency
  • Cleaner stock planning
  • Lower handling cost
  • Smoother repeat orders
3

Margin-Friendly Pricing

Pricing reflects production, packaging, logistics and risk handling, not inflated brand premiums or stacked reseller markup.

Result: more room for local pricing strategy and repeat business.

4

Built for Repeat Supply

Best suited for local stockists, repeat buyers and distributors who need predictable replenishment with less operational friction.

Best fit: local resale, recurring restocks and long-term supply coordination.

Supply Assurance System

DISPATCH FLOW

Logistics & Shipping

Fast outbound handling built for repeat supply instead of one-off retail dispatch.

  • Dispatch uses the selected warehouse
  • Destination country is checked at checkout
  • Out-of-stock products cannot be ordered

Outcome: easier expectation-setting for downstream buyers.

RISK HANDLING

Customs & After-Sales

Operational risk stays visible in the order and support workflow instead of being hidden from the buyer.

  • Country-specific delivery eligibility
  • Product and COA support remains available
  • Order context is retained for follow-up

Outcome: less uncertainty when handling cross-border repeat orders.

COORDINATION

Communication & Support

Repeat purchasing only works when communication stays predictable.

  • Telegram and WhatsApp can be configured
  • Support links are controlled from the backend
  • Existing contact and account paths stay available

Outcome: fewer blind spots between payment, dispatch and support.
